title: Hong Kong Reports 21 Mpox Cases Since August, Urges High-Risk Groups to Vaccinate
detail: Hong Kong health authorities reported 21 mpox cases recorded since August 2026, urging high-risk groups to seek vaccination amid a sustained transmission trend. The outbreak reflects broader global mpox concerns as health officials warned the situation requires continued vigilance.
